law_name: Act on the Implementation of the General Data Protection Regulation (AIGDPR)
key_requirements: Supplements GDPR, supervisory authority rules, video surveillance and biometric data rules
data_categories: Personal data; sensitive data (incl. genetic & biometric)
deceased_data: No specific rules on deceased persons' data; GDPR (recital 27) covers living persons only
research_exemption: Act contains specific provisions on processing for statistical purposes; otherwise GDPR art. 89 safeguards for research and archiving apply (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: Special category (art. 9 GDPR); processing genetic data to calculate disease risk for life insurance or endowment contracts banned even with explicit consent
notes: Replaced the earlier national data protection act; published in Narodne novine 42/2018
